market.what: PGM refining/separation service (Pt, Pd, Rh, Ru, Ir) from chloride leach, primary + recycled, world
market.method: est. (7.03 Moz Pt + 9.37 Moz Pd) x $15/oz + ~1.0 Moz Rh x $85/oz + ~1.3 Moz Ru/Ir x ~$40/oz = ~$0.4B; reports span $0.1B-6.9B, not used

value.logic: PGM flow ~$29B/yr (Pt $10.5B, Pd $10.3B, Rh ~$8B): 1 month shorter refining pipeline = $2.4B less WIP x 8% = $190M; +1% recovery on ~$8.3B recycled Pt/Pd/Rh = $80M
value.revenue_logic: license + extractant/resin supply to 1-2 refiners or autocat recyclers: ~2% of value created
value.margin_logic: mostly license fee; extractant inventory small and recycled in SX loop

trend.drivers: autocat recycling double-digit growth 2026; Pt/Ru/Ir deficits (PEM electrolysis Ir, HDD Ru); falling Russian and SA mine supply
trend.deadline: EU CRMA 2030 benchmark: 25% of strategic raw materials (incl. PGMs) from recycling

competition.paper_query: platinum palladium rhodium separation chloride solution
competition.notes: Closed club of in-house refiners; IBC molecular-recognition resins already used in PGM refining. No VC-backed startup found on single-PGM chloride binders; academic work active (DES, BACT Pt precipitant)

lab.synth: 1-2 step custom: amide/amine or thioether ligands; 3 variants
lab.test: batch SX/IX from synthetic 1-6 M HCl leach (Pt, Pd, Rh, Ir + Fe, Al, Ce, Ni), then real autocat leach; ICP-OES/ICP-MS distribution ratios and separation factors; university hydromet lab
lab.logic: synth 5 wk + tests 4 wk; 3 x $6k CRO + PGM salts ~$3k + ~100 ICP x $50 + autocat leach prep ~$2k

sale.gates: refiner bench + mini-plant SX loop on real feed 6-12 mo; extractant stability in strong HCl/oxidant; refinery change control
